dogecoin.text:
I spent a few hours searching for an old hard drive which would contain a bunch of dogecoin I bought in 2014.

Alas, I think it’s gone forever, but I found a bunch of old notebooks from the early days of building https://t.co/lWepprFqmW 😅 https://t.co/rAgVJbFh7M

I bought about 500k of dogecoin in 2014, forgot about it and lost the hard drive with the wallet on it.

Not my favorite thing to think about.
